## Code style

- Always use tabs for indentation.
- Never write comments explaining what the next line does.
- Run `pnpm test` before every commit.

## Workflow

- Always use tabs for indentation.
- Prefer small, focused pull requests.

```bash
# This is example code, not an instruction — the scanner must ignore it.
- Always use spaces, never tabs
```
